program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement in Fire Fighter I
outcomes: Understand and correctly apply appropriate communication protocols used in the fire service.
Don and doff personal protective equipment properly and use self-contained breathing apparatus.
Demonstrate a force entry into a structure, exit a hazardous area safely as a team, and connect to a water supply to extinguish fire.

notes: The catalog prints the codes with hyphens (FT-225A18, FT-226A1). These match the closed-list codes FT 225A18 and FT 226A1.
The PDF extraction put each outcome's list number at the end of its first line. The numbers were removed and each outcome's lines were joined into one entry.
The block's stated total of 19 units is taken from 'Total Required Units: 19.0', which covers the whole Major Field list.
The page goes on to unrelated programs (Front End Development/User Experience Design and Game Design and Animation). Those sections were ignored.
